tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rdzogs pa chen po bka' 'dus kyi: rtsa sgrub snying po don 'dus las: phrin las snying por bsdus pa bzhugs:1$0000300

bka' 'dus rtsa ba'i snying tig go / ྈྈྈྈྈ bla ma he ru ka la 'dud: 1$0000250rdzogs pa chen po bka' 'dus kyi: rtsa sgrub snying po kun 'dus las: phrin las snying por bsdus pa bstan: sbyor dngos rjes kyis nyams su blang: dang po sngon du 'gro ba ni: 1$0000300hūm̐: rang rig gdod nas dag pa la: bgegs dang log 'dren ming yang med: snang srid sku dang ye shes ngang: 'ja' zer thig le kun tu 'bar: rdo rje srung ba'i 'khor lo yis: glo bur bgegs tshogs mtshams bcad do: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa bh+rūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos rnams kun bzang mchod sprin che: phyi nang gsang mchod lhun gyis grub: 'di ltar snang ba'i 'dod yon kun: bde ba chen po'i rgyan du shar: oṃ sarba pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐: 1$0000250gnyis pa dngos gzhi ting 'dzin ni: 1$0000300hūm̐: ngo bo ka nas dag pa la: rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i rtsal: thugs rje mkha' khyab dkyil 'khor che: dbus su kun bzang yab dang yum: 'og tu dpal chen che ba'i mchog: steng du bka' drin sum ldan rje: phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi zhi dang khro: de yi mu ran 'ja' zer klong: rgyal ba sras bcas khro bo'i tshogs: bar khyams sgrub sde chen po brgyad: mu ran bka' sdod pho nya'i tshogs: phyi khyams theg pa rim dgu'i lha: ye shes mgon po lcam dral sogs: bstan srung phrin las rnam bzhi'i bdag: nyi ma las ni 'od zer bzhin: snang ba gzhir rdzogs dkyil 'khor gsal: sku gsung thugs dang ye shes lnga: lhun gyis grub pa'i bdag nyid bsgom: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: hūm̐: chos dbyings 'gyur med zhing khams nas: 'od gsal ye shes chen po'i lha: kun bzang che mchog zhi dang khro: gnyis med tshul gyis gshegs su gsol: badz+ra sa mā dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: a ti pū ho: pra tits+tsha ho: hūm̐: dbyings kyi rgyan rdzogs mchod pa'i sprin:

phyi nang gsang ba bla med pa: gnyis su med pa'i tshul du 'bul: bde ba chen po'i ngang du bzhes: ma hā sarba ga ṇa tsakra pū dza ho: hūm̐: ngo bo ka dag spros dang bral: rang bzhin lhun grub 'od gsal mdangs: thugs rje rig rtsal lug rgyud lha: ye rdzogs zhi khro'i lha la bstod: kun kyang 'od 'bar gzi brjid che: sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan tshogs: rab 'phel mkha' khyab rgyal ba mchod: sems can rnams la zhugs pa yis: gnas 'gyur zhi khro'i lha ru gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu h+ya dz+nyā na bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: 1$0000250gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni: 1$0000300hūm̐: dbyings kyi rang bzhin bhan+dha ru: rig pa ye shes bdud rtsis bkang: lhun grub mdangs rtsal 'dod yon 'phro: chos dbyings rgyan du sprin ltar gtibs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: ye shes rang shar lha tshogs la: 'dod yon rang grol tshogs mchod 'bul: dbyer med ngang du bskang zhing bshags: gnyis 'dzin blo zad ngang du bsgral: ma dag 'khrul pa'i phung po rnams: re dogs med pa'i dbyings su bstab: bh+yo: rig pa rang shar bka' sdod rnams: rten cing 'brel 'byung dam tshig rdzas: bka' yi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub mdzod: hūm̐: lhun grub rig rtsal phyir shar ba: nang dbyings chen po'i dbyings su bsdu: gdod nas skye ba med pa las: rang bzhin dkyil 'khor 'ja' ltar shar: snang srid sku dang ye shes ngang: lhun grub ngang du mngon sangs rgyas: a a a: 1$0000250de ltar nyams su blangs pa yis: snang bzhi mthar phyin rdo rje'i sku: 'od gsal 'pho ba chen po 'grub: sa ma ya rgya rgya: 1$0000300 sprul pa'i gter chen o rgyan mchog gyur bde chen gling pas mdo khams nam mkha' mdzod kyi lho phyogs g.yu 'bar brag nas spyan drangs pa'i shog ser glegs bam gyi ngos las/ phrin las 'gro 'dul dbang gi gnas mchog ri bo dbang zhu'i snying po zla gam dbang chen phug tu gtan la phab pa'i yi ge pa ni pad+ma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/// /
